annotations.title: Create a LinkedIn lead gen form

description: Create a LinkedIn LEAD GEN FORM — the form a lead gen ad opens, prefilled from the member’s LinkedIn profile so they submit in two taps. Owned by an ad account (adAccountId, the usual choice for ads) or a company Page (pageId). Give it a name (only shown in Campaign Manager), the headline people see, the questions (predefined fields LinkedIn prefills, plus custom text or multiple-choice questions), a privacy policy URL, optional consent checkboxes, a thank-you message and a thank-you button with its landing page. Created PUBLISHED by default — LinkedIn still lets you edit every field until a running ad uses it. Read back from LinkedIn before you are told it exists. Then attach it with create_linkedin_ads_creative(leadFormId) under a LEAD_GENERATION campaign. A form cannot spend money. Free.

adAccountId.description: own the form by this ad account

description.description: form description shown under the headline (optional)

headline.description: the title of the form people see

hiddenFields.description: tracking values carried on every lead, {name: value}, max 20

name.description: internal name, shown in Campaign Manager

pageId.description: Or own it by a company Page

privacyPolicyUrl.description: your privacy policy URL — LinkedIn shows it on the form

questions.description: the fields to ask, in order: predefined names LinkedIn prefills from the member profile (FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, WORK_EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, COMPANY_NAME, JOB_TITLE, SENIORITY, COMPANY_SIZE, INDUSTRY, CITY, COUNTRY, ZIP_CODE, LINKEDIN_PROFILE_LINK …; friendly spellings like "work email" work) and/or custom questions {question, type:"text", maxLength?} or {question, options:[2–15 choices]}

thankYouCta.description: thank-you button label: visit website, learn more, view now, download or try now

thankYouLandingPage.description: where the thank-you button sends people

thankYouMessage.description: message shown to the person after they submit the form
